title: Was Mesoplanet replaced with the Vale?

replies.author: itaity
replies.body:
Mesoplanet was removed due to its issues, and the Vale was added because the map devs finished testing it and approved it.
Those 2 are completely different maps and i dont think theres a connection between the removal of one and the addition of the another.
I hope that the map devs will spot and solve the problem off Mesoplanet and readd it soon.
